summary_notes: Marigold Concierge Ops runs SaaS for boutique hospitality chains; heavy Zendesk volume with seasonal spikes (Black Friday, holidays). Primary goal: reduce TTR and deflection by automating ticket summaries and tags so L1 agents can close faster. Wants high precision for tags (>=90%) and terse summaries (1-3 lines). Careful about EU customer data residency and needs SOC2 evidence. Interested in Redwood's routing policies to degrade gracefully under spikes.
technical_requirements:
- Summarization latency target: median end-to-end under 400ms for short tickets, 95th < 1s in POC.
- Tagging precision target: precision >= 90% for top 25 tags.
- Integration: Zendesk app (sandbox), webhook-based macro insertion, ability to run in VPC for EU traffic.
- Throughput: sustained 300 reqs/min baseline, burst to 3k reqs/min during peak windows.
- Audit: immutable audit logging per ticket and retention controls for 13 months.
- Key management: customer-provided KMS for private deployments.
evaluation_notes: POC asks: sample 30k ticket export, schema mapping for fields, list of canonical tags, example macros. Wants side-by-side A/B sample of Redwood summaries vs current heuristic summaries. Success metrics: %agent time saved, mean handle time, tag recall/precision. Legal requests NDA countersign before dataset share.
pricing_notes: Prelim model: hybrid — hosted API for dev + Dedicated for production spikes. Estimated ARR range based on committed throughput: $50k-$150k. Interested in committed burst credits. Need formal quote after POC sizing.
